description: The groups of a space (docs/spec/groups.md): the stored checks, the drawn rectangles, the group commands and their refusals, the rectangle operations and the drop resolution. A case reads its layout, the stored form {state, groups, leader, lastCard}, with the options gap, minSize, head and the size of the plane, then runs its steps; a case with throws refuses its layout with that text, which the reader of projects.json prefixes with the project and the space. A step runs call with args and returns its result or throws its text. create, split, close, dissolve, rename, leader and move are the commands core.group.create, core.card.split, core.card.close, core.group.dissolve, core.group.rename, core.group.leader and core.card.move without tabs; grid returns xs, ys and the cards of the grid without paidBy; stored returns groups, leader and lastCard with the members of each group in reading order; rect returns the drawn rectangle of a card; path returns the group path of core.card.get; level returns the level of a card; drop returns the card and the zone that a drop at a point resolves to. A value in a refusal text is its JSON text.
